title: Art of Street Photography Guided Walk
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a guided street photography tour of Vancouver, beginning at the Vancouver Art Gallery's šxʷƛ̓ənəq Xwtl’e7énḵ Square. Capture the architecture of the gallery and the energy of the square amidst urban landscapes. Explore light, shadows, reflections, and other classic street photography techniques. 

Continue down Granville Street, documenting the dynamic street scenes, vibrant storefronts, colorful alleys, and the diverse mix of people. Visit the striking Central Library with its mix of modern and classical architecture. 

We will conclude our tour by stopping at some of our favourite spots on Robson Street, to capture the dynamic flow of shoppers.
